newsitem.title: UK: LCI may advance Capital Corp bid deadline.
newsitem.headline: LCI may advance Capital Corp bid deadline.

text.p: London Clubs International Plc is considering shortening the deadline for acceptances of its hostile bid for rival casino group Capital Corp Plc to avoid clashing with the British election.
"We don't want to be competing with John Major so we may cut a few days off the end of it," London Clubs chief executive Alan Goodenough told the Financial Times.
Under the normal 60-day bid timetable, the final date for acceptances of the 196 million stg all-paper offer is May 3.
Prime Minister Major has called the election for May 1. London Clubs obviously fears that the election will divert attention from its bid for Capital.
Capital owns London casinos Crockfords and the Colony Club while London Clubs has seven casinos in the capital.
London Clubs shares were little changed at 417p at midday on Thursday, valuing Capital shares at 196p each.

However, Capital shares are trading at 207.5p. The premium to the offer reflects the market view that London Clubs may raise its offer or that larger betting and hotel company Ladbroke Group Plc could enter the fray.
